//==
// # Scene instancing and levels of detail
//
// Placed copies of the meshes in a SceneResources pool: single instances, the
// hardware-instanced form that shares one mesh across many transforms, and
// discrete level-of-detail groups. Mesh and Material fields are indices into
// SceneResources; distances are unit-agnostic scene Numbers.

// One placed copy of a mesh: Mesh and Material index into SceneResources;
// Transform is in world space.
type MeshInstance
    implements IValue
{
    Mesh: MeshIndex;
    Material: MaterialIndex;
    Transform: TrsTransform3D;
}
